title: Critical fibres of a C¹ map ℝ^{m+k} → ℝᵐ are Hᵏ-null for almost every value
statement: Let m, k ∈ ℕ, V ⊆ ℝ^{m+k} open, and G : ℝ^{m+k} → ℝᵐ of class C¹ on V. Then for Lᵐ-almost every y ∈ ℝᵐ, μHE[k]({x ∈ V : DG(x) is not surjective} ∩ G⁻¹{y}) = 0. Here μHE[k] is Mathlib's Euclidean-normalized k-dimensional Hausdorff measure on ℝ^{m+k} and Lᵐ = volume.
lean_statement: ∀ (m k : ℕ) (V : Set (Rn (m + k))) (G : Rn (m + k) → Rn m), IsOpen V → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 G V → ∀ᵐ y ∂(volume : Measure (Rn m)), μHE[k] ({x | x ∈ V ∧ ¬ Function.Surjective (fderiv ℝ G x)} ∩ G ⁻¹' {y}) = 0
